ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets opened lower, with Bitcoin slipping below $84,000 and major altcoins trailing between 1.7% and 5.2% on the Delta India exchange. Negative price pressure is compounded by regulatory headwinds in Europe and the abrupt shutdown of the Abstract layer‑2, while fresh listings of QNT, MOVR, ARK, SOON and BTW offer limited upside.
